snippet.title: Neocron Trailer - cyberpunkgaming.net
snippet.description:
NEOCRON is a 2002 post-apocalyptic cyberpunk massively multiplayer online role playing game set in the middle of the 28th century, approximately 600 years after a nuclear war between the Federation of the Free World and the Chinese Empire turned Earth into a wasteland. This premise is really nothing new, but Reakktor has done a great job of freshening up what seems like a tired concept. Neocron’s story, which is related in the game’s manual, is very well written and makes use of all the traditional postapocalyptic story elements: much of the world is dirty and run-down, mutant animals and insects can be found everywhere, and civilization is confined to closed cities like Neocron.

See more at:     cyberpunkgaming.net
